scope: Bounded retained-event recovery, immutable diagnostic preview and compiled Engine package provenance

Actual CLI and Rust FFI reads preserve exact replay and verify the running Engine compiled record without opening output.

A non-Git archive does not inherit its parent checkout identity.
The compiled stamp remains unchanged after a real hashed source input changes.
New provenance test fixtures remain retained.
